# VibeShield v7.0 — Complete Technical Reference (llms-full.txt)

## Overview
VibeShield v7.0 is a zero-dependency Node.js 20+ security scanner and online workbench designed for pre-launch verification of AI-built web applications (Lovable, Bolt.new, Cursor, v0, Next.js, Vite, Supabase, Firebase).

## 6 Real Read-Only Audit Phases
1. **TLS Port 443 & DNS CNAME Takeover:** Direct `node:tls` handshake (TLSv1.3 vs weak TLS 1.0/1.1, cipher suite, CA issuer, expiry countdown, SANs) and DNS `CNAME` dangling subdomain checks across 12 cloud providers.
2. **Multi-Route Crawl & Uncapped JS Bundles:** Crawls `/`, `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, Next.js `_buildManifest.js`, and core app routes; unpacks up to 24 JS chunks (up to 2.5MB each); discovers `/api/*`, `/trpc/*`, `/graphql`; scans 52 high-precision credential signatures.
3. **28 SPA-Filtered Nuclei-Grade Probes & SourceMaps:** Probes `/.env*`, `/.git/HEAD`, `/.git/config`, `/.DS_Store`, `/swagger.json`, `/openapi.json`, `/api-docs`, `/graphql` & `/api/graphql` Introspection, `/wp-json/wp/v2/users`, `/actuator/health`, `/actuator/env`, `/phpinfo.php`, `/server-status`, `/.well-known/security.txt`, `/firebase.json`, `/next.config.js`, `/package.json`, `/backup.sql`, `/dump.sql`, `/debug/vars`, `/metrics`, Open Redirect, CORS credential reflection, and `.js.map` SourceMaps while filtering SPA fake-200 HTML responses.
4. **Supabase (up to 20 Tables) & Firebase DB Probes:** Read-only PostgREST `HEAD Prefer: count=exact` checks (zero PII downloaded) + RPC & Storage bucket inventory; read-only Firebase RTDB (`/.json?shallow=true`) & Cloud Firestore (`documents?pageSize=1`) exposure checks.
5. **Mozilla Observatory Headers, CSP AST & Passive CVEs:** Parses CSP directives (`unsafe-inline`, `unsafe-eval`, wildcard `*`, `frame-ancestors`, `object-src`, `base-uri`), HSTS (`max-age >= 31536000`, `includeSubDomains`, `preload`), COOP/CORP, Cookies, and passive framework CVE advisories (`CVE-2025-29927`, `CVE-2025-48757`, legacy jQuery/Apache/Nginx/WordPress/PHP).
6. **Live Execution Trace & Calibrated Score:** Emits full `executionTrace[]` telemetry and calibrated 0-100 score.

## Interactive Zero-Install Security Generators (Free)
- **Supabase RLS Policy SQL Generator**: https://zcoldwater.github.io/vibeshield-cli/supabase-rls-policy-generator.html — Compiles idempotent, transaction-wrapped `ENABLE` & `FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY` migrations with `(SELECT auth.uid())` initPlan caching across 6 presets (user-owned, multi-tenant orgs, public read + owner write, service-role only, private storage bucket, batch CVE-2025-48757 lockdown) plus verification SQL and Cursor/Lovable repair prompts.
- **Next.js Nonce CSP & Security Headers Builder**: https://zcoldwater.github.io/vibeshield-cli/nextjs-nonce-csp-builder.html — Live CSP AST security grader + config generator for `middleware.ts` (per-request cryptographic nonce + `'strict-dynamic'`), `vercel.json`, Cloudflare Workers, and Nginx with 10/10 Mozilla Observatory headers.
